description: Five-cycle latches (168|10, 181|1, bit 183) and the slow 0x501 / 0x502 codes. Exploratory unless stated; numbers from the research workspace, every stored drive of three cars; drives anonymised; no payloads.

five_cycle_latches.structure: five sticky per-track latches, one per phase of age mod 5; a set phase stays set until the track ends
five_cycle_latches.phase_per_track: pooled by the header record counter mod 5 the flags are flat (168 0.49-0.56, 181 0.57-0.60); within-segment phase agreement at chance (168 0.26 vs 0.26, 181 0.22 vs 0.29)
five_cycle_latches.183_velocity_change_window: over-ground speed 3 records before vs 4 after the first latch record of an adjacent pair
five_cycle_latches.independent_recheck: own decode on the slot corpus: P(168 | predicted) 0.966, 168 latch predicted share 0.77, 183 655 pairs 0.827 / +9.0 m/s, 181 existence median 80 -> 39

a502_codes.behaviour: both words stored across power cycles (drive starts within a median 2 / 4-6 codes of the previous drive's end), frozen below about 5 m/s, paused in turns (owner change share 0.34 -> 0.05 and 0.68 -> 0.16 above 0.1 rad/s yaw)

a501_code.startup: 31, then placeholder 16 for about 6.9 s, then the stored value

per_drive_r_with_calibration_pitch.note: range over averaging methods (medians / means / after 5 min)
